items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private, keep Woot permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public or commercial redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Revenue is $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress is partial official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy evidence only; no task is closable. Keep all 4 tasks open. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.
